# Source-backed Crystal fixture

The original Kemal `src/kemal/null_log_handler.cr` is retained with its MIT
notice. Its complete 313 physical bytes have SHA256
`3cdbdb592bd5c9dc070116df3491c9f6046de181d4936878240e0d1d47765d48`.
The finite witnesses cover a written class, its two direct methods and lexical
containment. Macro expansion, overloads and runtime dispatch are not inferred.
